entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed scale operand has %s sample schema
entries.rationale: lowerMulOrDivScaleOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp hands it the Mixed VectorSetOp lowerMixedExpHistogramSetOp builds, and lowerUnary and scaleMixedPlanUnderPolicy (the entry for lowerVectorScalar and foldSyntheticVectorBinary) reach it only behind a mixedRowsNeedPreparation check, which holds exactly when liveSampleKind answers SampleKindMixed. Another kind is an internal caller-contract violation, not a query shape.
